rules.note: 质量和可观察性限制；具体拒答/多面板处理为本项目操作规则。
CE 形态；对 CE4/5 使用支持性与不确定措辞，不宣称单张图像必然确诊。
CL 与早期 CE 定性边界。
AE 独立路径；EMUC 是形态模式而非 CE 分期。
鉴别诊断；核对正常解剖结构身份是项目读图检查步骤，不是新增诊断算法。
基于数据模态限制的项目推论：不补造动态、多普勒、造影或其他检查信息。
连续患病概率及 null 是项目输出规则，不是指南阈值或已校准风险模型；不推导任意征象到概率的数值映射。
本项目证据核对与 JSON 输出规则，不声称医学证据已验证模型效果。

evidence_handling.source_disagreement: WHO 2025 lists some distinctive CE4/5 appearances, whereas 2017 expert reliability work stresses etiologic uncertainty. Preserve appearance descriptions but do not equate calcification/solid texture alone with diagnosis.
evidence_handling.case_leakage: Only general rules are included, not individual-case captions, labels, UUIDs or source prevalence. Public-image reuse and pretraining overlap cannot be ruled out.
evidence_handling.physician_experience: Published expert reading studies and training studies; no interviews or clinical endorsement claimed.
evidence_handling.reading_scope: 7 full-text relevant-section readings, 3 abstract-only readings and 1 indexed-section reading; not a systematic review.
evidence_handling.excluded_clinical_workflow: FASE suspected-case referral rule is not a final binary diagnosis; omitted from model classification rules.
evidence_handling.prompt_revision: The softened guidance and probability framing are project-level prompting hypotheses, not newly validated clinical rules or feature-to-probability mappings.

change_note: 医学形态、11份来源及K01–K08结构保留；将医学判断措辞改为条件性辅助观察，减少确诊门槛暗示，区分未显示与不存在，要求替代解释有图像依据；概率协议、基础提示词、拒答标准、参考图和模型参数不变。依据最后四组50张运行形成开发假设，未宣称效果改善。
